# audit-event-schema

> A strict audit event model with canonical JSON: who did what to which target with what outcome, validated fields, UTC millisecond time and a refusal of secret attributes Python package `trysac-audit-event-schema`, import name `audit_event_schema`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
